title: Tadap ke turbat me shah ki mayyat
body:
TADAP KE TURBAT MEIN SHEH KI MAYYAT
LAHU KEY AANSU BAHA RAHI HAI…..
ALI KI BETI LAHAD PE MAA KI
NISHAN RASAN KEY DIKHA RAHI HAI…..
SUBHA SE LEKAR WO SHAAM-E-GHURBATH
AJEEB HANGAAM-E-ZINDAGI THA
JO BITI KARBOBALA KEY BAN MEIN
WO HAAL MAA KO SUNA RAHI HAI…..
<<MINI>>
TADAP KE TURBAT…..
<<DIVIDER>>
HUWI WO KARBOBALA MEIN SHADI
LAGI HAI KUBRA KO RUN MEIN MEHENDI
USI SAYI MEIN YE DUNIYA AB TAK
SARAO PE MAHENDI UTHA RAHI HAI…..
<<MINI>>
TADAP KE TURBAT…..
<<DIVIDER>>
SINA JO RUN MEIN HAI KHAYE AKBER
GAYE JO AKBER NA AYE AKBER
HAMARE QALBO JIGAR MEIN BARCHI
JAB HI SE DASTI HI JAARAHI HAI…..
<<MINI>>
TADAP KE TURBAT…..
<<DIVIDER>>
GALE PAR ASGHAR NE TEER KHAYA
LEHAD MEIN BHI WO SUKUN NA PAYA
JALA HUA WO HAI LAAYI JHULA
JO MAA KO ZAINAB BATA RAHI HAI…..
<<MINI>>
TADAP KE TURBAT…..
<<DIVIDER>>
JARI KO ROKA GAYA HAI RUN SE
TAMAM BACCHE HAI RUN MEIN PYASE
ALAM JO ABBAS NE UTHAYA
USE YEH ZAINAB UTHA RAHI HAI…..
<<MINI>>
TADAP KE TURBAT…..
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN BHAI KO KARBALA MEIN
RULA RULA KEY YAZID MAARA
NASHANI BHAAI KA THA JO KURTA
LAHU BHARA WO DIKHA RAHI HAI…..
<<MINI>>
TADAP KE TURBAT…..
<<DIVIDER>>
SAKINA BIBI KA WO TADAPNA
MILA NA BABA KA HAMKO SEENA
KAHO TO IQBAL KYA KAHU MEIN
WO KHOON KE AANSU RULA RAHI HAI…..
<<MINI>>
TADAP KE TURBAT…..
